title: Chapter 142 Drunken Immortal Tower
content:
Chapter 142 Drunken Immortal Tower

In Jicheng, pedestrians are coming and going, and the voice of hawkers is endless. There are shops on both sides, and a variety of goods are piled up everywhere.

Feeling this bustling big city, Zhong Yu slightly sighed.

"Worthy of being the capital of a country, Yan, as the seven heroes of the Warring States that can stand side by side with Qin, really has its differences. You can see it just by looking at the prosperity of the capital!"

"Yeah, I don't know when the Changchun City I'm waiting for will be able to achieve this scene!" Zhao Yun beside him also sighed slightly, his eyes also looking forward to the prosperous scene of Changchun City in the future.

"I'm afraid of the ball. Although this city is prosperous, there are still too few people. There are only more than 200,000 people in the cage, but it is only the essence of the entire Yan Kingdom that has gathered this scene." Mouth disdain.

"Yes, my lord. Although I have few people in Changchun City, there are 100,000 people. There are also tens of thousands or more than 10,000 people in other prefectures and prefectures. Although they are weaker than this city, other local cities , but it is much better than the rest of the country of Yan, as can be seen from the desolate scenery we have walked along the way!" Zhao Yun also persuaded from the side.

"It's okay, you two don't need to be like this, whether it's good or bad, I still have a certain idea in my heart!" With a laugh, Zhong Yu explained.

"Okay, let's not talk about this for now, the most urgent thing is to find an inn to stay, otherwise we will have no place to rest at night when it gets dark!" The conversation changed, and Zhong Yu changed the subject.

"Haha, what the lord said is that I should consider this issue right now, or should the lord be thoughtful, we are negligent, don't blame, don't blame!" Zhang Fei said with some embarrassment, as a courtier, let his own My lord, it is really negligent of my duty to think about the next itinerary for myself and others.

...

Zuixianlou, a well-known restaurant in the country of Yan. Its branches are open all over the country of Yan. Almost as long as there is a city in the country of Yan, there is Zuixianlou, which shows its background and influence.

Looking at the restaurant in front of me, the exterior is magnificent, the interior is luxuriously decorated, and every detail has been carefully thought out, all of which reflect the innkeeper's sense of magnanimity.

It's just the decoration of the inn in front of him, the layout that ordinary people have never seen, everything, in Zhong Yu's eyes, he doesn't pay much attention to it, instead he thinks about another layer.

These restaurants are opened all over the country of Yan, some are luxurious and some are simple, but there is one thing, that is, they are all under the name of one owner.

What does this mean? It means that there is a person who has spread his intelligence network throughout the entire country of Yan.

Inns and restaurants have always been a place where fish and dragons mix together. Passers-by and knight-errants from the rivers and lakes all stop here to rest. Among them, they order a few bowls of wine in the lobby. The news is bragging and farting, and the surprised and amazed eyes of your companions are your pride.

As the owner of a restaurant, he can naturally sort out detailed information one after another based on what he has heard. Although most of them are meaningless, some important information is often hidden in the ordinary. It's just the perception of those who care.

However, it is so difficult to open such a restaurant.

Without a certain identity background, power can affect the rise and fall of a country. If you want to open a chain store in a country, this kind of chain store that can endanger the rule of a country is unnecessary. Is it true that the heads of the ancients are all wood?

This kind of strategy was mentioned in a separate article in his Sun Tzu's Art of War by Sun Tzu, the sage of soldiers hundreds of years ago.

Therefore, Zhong Yu could only sigh slightly, and let go of this thought in his heart. This kind of restaurant can only be opened within his own territory.

"Hey, my lords, are you going to be a top student or staying in a hotel?" The boy standing at the door of the inn saw these gorgeously dressed guests walking towards the inn from a distance, and they ran up enthusiastically. hospitality.

"Well, let's eat something here and stay in a hotel!" Zhong Yu thought for a while, and looked at this inn, which is indeed better. The decoration and meals are more comprehensive. Even if other places are better than this place, they are not as good No matter where to go, I agreed.

"Okay, my lord, what do you want to eat? We have braised shark's fin, nine-turn large intestine..." The young man enthusiastically introduced the characteristics of the store, but before he finished speaking, he was directly greeted impatiently. Zhong Yu was interrupted.

"Okay, don't talk about this anymore, just serve me all your famous dishes. Don't you know after a taste? Don't worry, I have plenty of money!" As he said, Zhao Yun, who was beside him, threw out A parcel of gold.

The boy opened the package and took a look. With his vicious eyes, he recognized at a glance that it was all pure gold, which is rare in the market. He was overjoyed and quickly put the money into his arms.

"Okay, my lords, please take your seat. There is no one in the Tianzihao private room upstairs. Please move your steps and go upstairs with the villain!" The smile on the boy's face became fuller, the money is enough Your lord, it's been a month since he ate and drank casually in this restaurant.

Zhong Yu nodded, motioned for the boy to lead the way, and walked towards the second floor together. Zhao Yun and the others behind him also hurriedly followed, not daring to be too far apart. Being in a different place, the safety of their lord's life is the most important thing.

When I came to the restaurant, I sat down quietly in a very elegantly decorated upper room, and then waited for the inn to serve the wine and food.

Not long after, all kinds of special dishes of this inn came up. At a glance, they are full of beauty. When you sniff your nose, you can smell the aroma. It can be said that it is delicious in color and fragrance.

After a signal, an attendant beside him went up. He took out a chopstick wrapped in a white Jinpa from his pocket, grabbed every dish, put it in his mouth quickly, and tasted it.

After a while, the attendant nodded and told Zhong Yu that there was nothing wrong with the dishes, then got up and stepped back, staying aside.

The boy serving food next to him felt slightly annoyed when he saw the actions of these customers in front of him. Could it be that our restaurant, which is in a legitimate business, will harm you.

But his face is more respectful, he is not an uninformed person, usually in the restaurant, he has received countless distinguished guests back and forth.

But there is this ostentation, there are people who are specially used to test dishes, I have not seen a few, but all of them are big nobles, big officials, and they are all powerful, and it is not a small person like myself who can provoke started.

In this way, Zhong Yu and others finished the meal under the complicated mood of the boy. This meal was very good, they hadn't eaten such a good meal for a long time, since they left Yuguo, they were exhausted from traveling all the way. Everywhere in Yan Kingdom is a dilapidated and desolate scene, so how can there be the prosperity of this capital city?

I think people like Zhong Yu can sleep well today!
